Also confirmed the 'Anything you add or change here is reviewed by an admin before it goes live' banner is rendered. Nothing critical failed.

minor.issue: The internal _collect() applies the caller's campus filter unconditionally, so users/guests/members with an empty location_id are invisible to the duplicate detector even to a global admin. The user request wanted 'auto-merge only exact groups' to cover records like the Lubega/Kaswabuli/Lubwama copies; if those were ever seeded without a campus they won't appear on the review list. Suggest mirroring the fix that list_families already has — treat missing/empty location_id as visible under any campus. Test added a location_id to the throwaway rows as a workaround so the merge test passes.

Non-blocking: primary_contact_name / primary_contact_phone / address were kept in the allowed set but empty-string clears are still filtered by `v not in (None,)`. An empty string DOES overwrite (address='' actually saves), which is fine for text fields but slightly asymmetric with the intentional location_id special-case. Consider documenting.

action_items: Consider loosening the campus filter inside dedupe._collect() so an admin's review list shows people-without-a-campus too (same reasoning as list_families' recent fix). Not blocking iter364.

Optional: skip the members.email uniqueness constraint for records created via 'household form' — right now the review workflow can produce two real profiles with matching emails elsewhere (users + guests), and 'promote a guest to a member' is blocked because a member with that email already exists. Not exercised in the spec but surfaced during testing.
critical_code_review_comments: dedupe.py _collect() — silently campus-scoped. Records without a location_id are invisible for detection even to system_admin. Aligning with families.py list_families would be safer.

families.py update_family — the empty-string special-case is only for location_id. If a user actively wants to clear notes or address, that works, but clearing location_id is impossible via the API. Fine as designed but worth calling out in the schema doc.

family_approvals.py _apply_change — writes guardian sub-doc fields via $set with `guardians.$.field`, matched only by guardian id. If a guardian was removed between submission and approval, the $set silently succeeds (matched_count=0) with no user-visible error. Consider surfacing a 'target no longer exists' response.
children.py _save_photo — good fix on the random suffix. But the old photo file is left in object storage forever; consider queuing a delete for the previous url.
